cues: The arrows give the resultant amplitude: A equals the square root of a one squared plus a two squared plus two a one a two cos phi.
Intensity goes as amplitude squared, so I equals I one plus I two plus two root I one I two cos phi.
That last part is the interference term: positive in step, negative out of step.
